infra.export.title: Export AWS profiles
infra.export.pick.label: Profiles to export
infra.export.secrets.warningTitle: Read this before you turn this on
infra.export.secrets.warning: A static access key written to a file is the riskiest thing in this whole feature family — it never expires, nobody can tell who is using it, and it travels with the file. If the goal is to let a teammate share an account, export the SSO config instead and have them run their own "sso login" — same result, and nobody has to hold anyone else's key.

infra.export.secrets.confirmHintEmpty: Pick at least one profile first.
infra.export.secrets.chmodNote: The file is written with permissions 600 (owner read/write only).

infra.export.preview.none: Pick at least one profile to preview.
